# production-block-without-naas.png

**Type:** ODA functional-block architecture diagram.
**Source context:** `## Internet Product with Fiber using NaaS`, left
column of the two-column comparison table for Figure 3 ("Comparison of
Production functional block without and with NaaS"), captioned "ODMs
view (as per UC3 & UC4)" — the traditional (pre-NaaS) landscape.

Same `Engagement Management` / `Party Management` / `Core Commerce
Management` / `Production` / `Intelligence Management` layered
structure as Figures 1-2. Inside `Production`, four separate ODM
domains are shown side by side, each a stack of `Service Catalog` /
`Service Orchestration` / `Service Inventory` boxes: `Fiber Domain` and
`Copper Domain` (both grouped under a "Fixed Service Access" bracket),
`Network Service Domain` (under "Fixed Connectivity"), and `Soft Service
Domain` (under "TV Channels"). No E2E Service Management domain or
composite/abstracted service layer is present at this stage — each ODM
exposes its own service catalog and orchestration independently.
